title: Chematica (Synthia) Plans Complex Natural-Product Syntheses Passing Expert Chemical Turing Test
whyItMatters: Published in Nature: solves the 50-year challenge of multistep computer-planned natural-product synthesis—passing a blind Turing test judged by top organic chemists and verified in wet-lab synthesis of three complex targets.
summary: Bartosz A. Grzybowski’s team (Polish Academy of Sciences, UNIST, and Northwestern University) solved the 50-year grand challenge of multistep organic synthesis planning in Nature with Chematica (now Merck’s Synthia). By augmenting deep heuristic search and an expert-curated reaction knowledge base with causal multi-step strategic planning, Chematica designed novel multistep syntheses for intricate natural products that proved indistinguishable from human-designed routes in a blind Turing-like test judged by world-leading synthetic chemists—and the team physically executed three of the AI-planned natural-product syntheses in the laboratory.
technicalHighlights: Overcame 50 years of single-step retrosynthesis limitations by combining causal multi-step strategic reasoning with AI search over chemical reaction networks.
Passed a blind chemical Turing test in which top synthetic organic chemists could not distinguish Chematica’s complex natural-product routes from human literature.
Physically validated three computer-designed multistep total syntheses of complex natural products in the wet laboratory.
caveats: Relies on a large expert-coded reaction rule library (~100,000 transformations) alongside AI search heuristics rather than pure end-to-end neural learning; indexed as a 2020 calibration anchor.
institutions: IBS Center for Soft and Living Matter

scoreRationale.foundational: Resolved the 50-year Corey/LHASA grand challenge of strategic multistep computer-planned synthesis of complex natural products.
scoreRationale.ripple: Commercialized globally as Synthia and directly shaped modern pharmaceutical synthesis planning and autonomous chemistry agents.
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Nature (2020) with blind expert Turing-test evaluation and full wet-lab experimental total syntheses.
scoreRationale.velocity: Generates expert-level multistep total-synthesis blueprints in minutes instead of weeks of manual literature planning.
